**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 4.4 "Audit Rights" (p0059) is the only provision in the agreement giving the counterparty inspection rights over us. It lands at or above the playbook's preferred position on every material term:

- **Frequency** — "no more than once each calendar year" (preferred: once per 12 months).
- **Notice / timing** — "at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice" (announced audit during reasonable hours).
- **Auditor** — "an independent certified public accountant reasonably acceptable to Corio," so we hold a veto; confidentiality is picked up by the Section 10 NDA.
- **Cost** — "Commerce One shall bear all costs and expenses of such inspection," shifting only on an underpayment "of more than five percent (5%)" — the preferred 5% threshold, better than the 10% fallback.
- **System access** — limited to books and records; no direct or remote access to our systems, so no walk-away trigger.

Noted but not redlined: notice is "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30 days, and auditor confidentiality is handled by the separate NDA rather than expressly in the clause. These are minor sub-elements and do not warrant a redline.
